justification: Inspected javaparser-symbol-solver-core/src/main/java/com/github/javaparser/symbolsolver/javaparsermodel/contexts/ArrayAccessExprContext.java, ExpressionContext.java, and AbstractJavaParserContext.java. The target class is only 96 lines and exposes just 2 public members: a constructor and solveSymbolInParentContext(String), and that override only delegates to super. The substantive resolution logic is implemented in the superclass chain, so ArrayAccessExprContext is a thin, single-purpose specialization rather than a class with insufficient modularization.
